paragraphs: It's Friday morning at school. Teacher Kim says, "Today we have a treasure game." "Every child has a paper with three lines." "Find the treasure before break!" Ben, May, and Sam read the first line. "Go to the third window," it says. "How do we know which window is first?" asks May. "It's the window next to the door," says Sam.

They find the third window and a small blue paper under it. "Look under the fifth chair," says the second line. Ben counts the chairs: one, two, three, four, five. Under the fifth chair, there is a red book. "Open the book at the twelfth page," says the third line. May opens the book slowly. Page twelve is not a story. It is a very small page. It has a picture of a small box.

Sam looks in the box. There is a paper in it. "Your homework: Smile at three people today." The children laugh. "This is the best homework!" says Ben. "I never have an easy homework," says Sam. They smile at Teacher Kim first. She smiles at them too. Then it's break. The children run outside and play.
